verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents several in-product Comply AI features that generate suggestions from customer data. Comply AI for Risk produces inherent and residual risk scores, treatments, and justifications. The platform auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes for failing tests, extracts answers from vendor SOC 2 reports and policies, and generates SSPs and POA&Ms from real-time compliance data. Missing for 10: a general in-product AI assistant or insights layer across all workspace data (the MCP server is external-client access, not in-product), any detail on how the AI insights work in depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
